neighbours.label: A non-initial piece of a rare word or name that the tokenizer splits into several tokens (rhabdomy|ol|ysis, t|ucker, Sagu|aro, Rajamou|li); common single-token words in the same slot do not fire

predictions: Rare names and technical words split into three or more tokens reach 0.4-1.1 on an inner or final piece. The same frames with common words or single-token names (cyst, pigeon, Dickens, Madrid, desert, rhyme, Plato, Chicago) stay under 0.1.
short: inner piece of a rare split word
notes: Probe: bush t|ucker 1.099, rhabdomy|ol|ysis 1.001, Sagu|aro 0.834, Rajamou|li 0.787, Campor|ore|se 0.441; pneumonia 0.059, roast lamb 0.025, Yellowstone 0.037, floor 0.041.
